info.title: GetGPX API
info.description:
## Getting started

Use the public ID from a track URL:

```sh
curl -H 'Accept: application/json' 'https://getgpx.com/api/v1/tracks/TRACK_ID'
curl 'https://getgpx.com/api/v1/tracks/TRACK_ID/analysis'
curl -OJ 'https://getgpx.com/api/v1/tracks/TRACK_ID/gpx'
```

Replace the example host with your deployment. Metadata contains no route points. The analysis contains geometry and shares the same metric, terrain and distribution types.

## Authentication

Public metadata, GPX and analysis require no authentication. Other operations require the HttpOnly getgpx_session cookie. Sign in on the website on the same origin; the browser sends its cookie automatically. The documentation Authorize dialog cannot set an HttpOnly cookie. Scripts can use an existing cookie jar with curl --cookie. Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity and renew on activity.

## Upload and processing

Send raw GPX with Content-Type: application/gpx+xml, a percent-encoded X-GPX-Filename and X-Track-Type. Successful uploads return 202 and Location. Poll the status URL until processing finishes. Existing results remain available during replacement. Mutation requests change your data; deletion is permanent.

## Data conventions

Distances use km, elevations and terrain lengths m, speeds km/h, durations ms and slopes percent. Dates use UTC ISO 8601. Missing measurements are null. IDs are opaque and case-sensitive. Lists are ordered newest first and use an opaque nextCursor, which is null at the end. JSON responses use data; analysis is a standalone document and GPX is a file. Parse error.code, not human-readable messages. PATCH changes only supplied fields. An empty externalLinks object clears links.

## Browser access

Requests from browser scripts must use the same origin. Direct server and CLI requests are supported. Safe top-level download links are permitted.

post.description: Requires a website session. Source is stored durably before 202; processing continues asynchronously. Poll the Location URL. User tier quota applies (BASIC: 100, PREMIUM: 1,000 by default).

Location.description: Relative URL of the owner-only processing status endpoint.

parameters.name: X-GPX-Filename
parameters.description: Percent-encoded filename ending in .gpx, up to 255 decoded characters. Path components are removed.

requestBody.description: Raw GPX bytes, not multipart/form-data. Maximum 25 MiB and 500,000 accepted route points.

get.description: Newest first, up to 24 items per page. Includes processing and failed tracks.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive title substring; whitespace is trimmed.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the previous page. Omit on the first request.

get.description: Newest saved first, up to 24 items per page; includes author information.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive title substring; whitespace is trimmed.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the previous page. Omit on the first request.

get.description: Track metadata, metrics, terrain, road distributions and points of interest. Route geometry is available at analysisUrl. During processing, available data is returned and revision is null until a result exists.

patch.description: Owner only. Updates only supplied fields. Omitted fields retain their values. An empty externalLinks object clears all links. Returns the current track. Metadata edits are saved immediately during processing and retained when analysis is published.

delete.description: Owner only. Permanently deletes metadata and stored objects. Repeating deletion of a missing ID succeeds. A track owned by someone else returns 404.

get.description: Owner only. Use after upload, GPX replacement or retry. A failed replacement does not remove the active result.

post.description: Owner only. Starts another analysis when processing.canRetry is true. Returns 404 for a missing track and 409 when another operation is running or retry is unavailable.

get.description: Requires a session. Returns saved=false when an existing track is not saved, or 404 when the track does not exist.

put.description: Idempotent. May also save your own track.

delete.description: Idempotent; returns saved=false even if the track or favorite is already missing.

put.description: Owner only. Replaces the original GPX, keeping the track ID and metadata. Existing files remain available until the new result is ready.

parameters.name: X-GPX-Filename
parameters.description: Percent-encoded filename ending in .gpx, up to 255 decoded characters. Path components are removed.

requestBody.description: Raw GPX bytes, not multipart/form-data. Maximum 25 MiB and 500,000 accepted route points.

get.description: Downloads the original GPX bytes through a same-origin URL. The active revision remains available during replacement; before first publication, the stored initial source is served.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment with sanitized filename and UTF-8 filename*.

get.description: Immutable analysis for the current revision, including route geometry. Compare revision with track metadata. Metrics describe this source revision; track metadata contains the current user-selected speed and duration. Returned directly from object storage.

post.description: Removes the selected items belonging to the current user. Returns only affected IDs. Duplicate IDs are processed once.
Removes the selected items belonging to the current user. Returns only affected IDs. Duplicate IDs are processed once.

sessionCookie.name: getgpx_session
sessionCookie.description: Existing HttpOnly website session. Sign in on the site; browser requests on this origin send it automatically. No token issuance endpoint.

PublicId.description: Opaque, case-sensitive public ID from the track URL. New IDs have 21 characters; clients must not depend on that length.

id.description: Stable category identifier; unknown categories must be tolerated.

komoot.description: Matching service HTTPS URL after trimming, or an empty string to remove the entry.

strava.description: Matching service HTTPS URL after trimming, or an empty string to remove the entry.

garmin.description: Matching service HTTPS URL after trimming, or an empty string to remove the entry.

rideWithGps.description: Matching service HTTPS URL after trimming, or an empty string to remove the entry.

ExternalLinks.description: Supported HTTPS links: komoot → komoot.com, strava → strava.com, garmin → garmin.com, rideWithGps → ridewithgps.com. Subdomains are accepted. Values are trimmed; empty strings remove entries; each trimmed value may contain at most 2048 characters. In PATCH, a supplied externalLinks object replaces all links; omitted externalLinks preserves them.

message.description: Optional human-readable message. Use code for programmatic handling.

step.description: Current stage while PROCESSING; null after processing finishes.

code.description: Known codes: INVALID_GPX (cannot parse usable route), GPX_POINT_LIMIT (too many route points), ENRICHMENT_UNAVAILABLE (route enrichment failed), ANALYSIS_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE (analysis could not be stored), TRACK_FILE_UNAVAILABLE (source could not be read), PROCESSING_INTERRUPTED (worker lease expired).

canRetry.description: Whether the owner may request another analysis attempt.

Processing.description: Outcome of the current processing attempt, independent of available revision data. A failed replacement can leave the previous revision available. READY with PARTIAL completeness and canRetry=true means usable analysis is available but optional enrichment can be retried.

step.description: Current stage while PROCESSING; null after processing finishes.

code.description: Known codes: INVALID_GPX (cannot parse usable route), GPX_POINT_LIMIT (too many route points), ENRICHMENT_UNAVAILABLE (route enrichment failed), ANALYSIS_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE (analysis could not be stored), TRACK_FILE_UNAVAILABLE (source could not be read), PROCESSING_INTERRUPTED (worker lease expired).

canRetry.description: Whether the owner may request another analysis attempt.

ProcessingStatus.description: Outcome of the current processing attempt, independent of available revision data. A failed replacement can leave the previous revision available. READY with PARTIAL completeness and canRetry=true means usable analysis is available but optional enrichment can be retried.

speedKmh.description: Speed used to estimate duration. Initially the moving average recorded in GPX when available, otherwise the default estimated speed; editable in metadata. Analysis retains the original value.

estimatedDurationMs.description: Expected duration in milliseconds: initially recorded moving time when available, otherwise distance divided by speedKmh. Editing speed or replacing the source recalculates it from distance and the selected speed.

durationMs.description: Elapsed time between the first and last recorded GPX timestamps; null when unavailable or non-positive.

movingTimeMs.description: Recorded time for segments travelling at least 1 km/h, capped at elapsed duration when available; null when no moving time is recorded.

movingAverageSpeedKmh.description: Distance over recorded moving segments divided by their moving time; null when unavailable.

averageSpeedKmh.description: Full route distance divided by elapsed GPX duration; null when duration is unavailable.

elevationChangeM.description: Positive elevation magnitude: accumulated gain for climbs, accumulated loss for descents.

score.description: Terrain classification score: segment length in metres multiplied by averageGradePercent, rounded to an integer.

sourceName.description: Original name from the GPX track, route or metadata; falls back to the filename without its extension. Unchanged by edits to the track title.

DownloadURLs.description: Available download formats mapped to same-origin URLs. An unavailable format is omitted; an empty object means no download is available. Additional formats may be added.

Error400.description:
Malformed JSON or cursor.

Codes: INVALID_JSON (malformed JSON), INVALID_CURSOR (invalid pagination cursor).

Error401.description:
A valid session is required.

Codes: AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED (missing session), INVALID_SESSION (expired or invalid session).

Error403.description:
Browser origin is not allowed.

Codes: CROSS_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN (cross-origin browser request).

Error404.description:
Track or resource not found.

Codes: TRACK_NOT_FOUND (unknown or inaccessible track), API_NOT_FOUND (unknown API route).

Error405.description:
Method not allowed.

Codes: METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED (unsupported method; see Allow).

Error409.description:
Operation conflicts with current state or quota.

Codes: TRACK_ANALYSIS_NOT_READY (no stored result), REPLACEMENT_IN_PROGRESS (another attempt is running), ANALYSIS_NOT_RETRYABLE (retry unavailable), TRACK_LIMIT_REACHED (account quota).

Error413.description:
Request body exceeds the permitted size.

Codes: GPX_FILE_TOO_LARGE (GPX exceeds 25 MiB), PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE (JSON body exceeds limit).

Error415.description:
Unsupported content type or encoding.

Codes: UNSUPPORTED_GPX_TYPE (unsupported GPX Content-Type), UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE (unsupported encoding or charset).

Error422.description:
Invalid request fields.

Codes: INVALID_REQUEST_BODY (empty, non-object or unknown PATCH fields), INVALID_TRACK_TITLE, INVALID_TRACK_SPEED, INVALID_ROUTE_TYPE, INVALID_EXTERNAL_LINKS, INVALID_GPX_FILENAME, INVALID_SEARCH_QUERY, INVALID_TRACK_IDS.

Error500.description:
Operation failed.

Codes: INTERNAL_ERROR, UPLOAD_FAILED, REPLACEMENT_FAILED.

Error502.description:
Stored file could not be read.

Codes: TRACK_FILE_UNAVAILABLE (stored file could not be read).

Error503.description:
File delivery is unavailable.

Codes: TRACK_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE (file delivery is unavailable).
